name: Confirm Modal
description: Generic confirmation dialog with customizable message (HTML, sanitized — scripts, images, iframes, embeds, objects, links, styles, inline event handlers stripped) and button label. Returns Promise<boolean>. Escape key and overlay click = cancel (false). Construction appends to DOM, open() makes visible and returns promise, done() cleans up and removes DOM.

interface.constructor: new ConfirmModal(message: string, confirmLabel?: string, destructive?: boolean)

methods.name: open
methods.description: Show overlay, focus cancel button, return promise resolved on confirm/cancel

methods.name: done
methods.description: Remove DOM and event listeners, resolve promise

security.html_sanitization: Strips
